chain.label: Lock ring missing from horizontal stabilizer trim actuator barrel
chain.trigger: the circular wire lock ring, which was designed to prevent the clamp nut from unscrewing, was not present

chain.label: Actuator clamp nut lacked a secondary retention feature
chain.trigger: a secondary locking feature is not required...single-point-failure hazard

chain.label: Unapproved moisture seal installed in actuator during maintenance
chain.trigger: maintenance personnel installed a moisture seal...not approved by the airplane manufacturer

chain.label: Clamp nut unscrewed from actuator barrel in flight
chain.trigger: the clamp nut that attaches the top eye end and bearing assembly...had unscrewed from the barrel

caused_by.evidence: the in-flight unthreading of the clamp nut from the horizontal stabilizer trim actuator barrel due to a missing lock ring
a missing or failed lock ring is a source of a single-point failure in the horizontal stabilizer actuator assembly

the moisture seal increased the rotational friction between the clamp nut and eye bolt, which has the potential to increase the rate of separation between the clamp nut and barrel in the absence of the lock ring

chain.label: Horizontal stabilizer moved beyond limits, pitch uncontrollable
chain.trigger: resulted in the horizontal stabilizer moving to an extreme trailing-edge-down position rendering the airplane's pitch uncontrollable

caused_by.evidence: the top eye end and bearing assembly of the horizontal stabilizer actuator separating from the barrel

chain.label: Airplane entered abrupt, uncontrollable near-vertical descent
chain.trigger: the airplane pitched up about 8° and then abruptly pitched down about 58°...continued in a nose-low, near-vertical descent

caused_by.evidence: a failure in the horizontal stabilizer trim actuator caused the accident airplane to abruptly pitch down during the accident sequence, from which recovery was not possible

chain.label: Airplane impacted water in Mutiny Bay
chain.trigger: impacted the water in Mutiny Bay, near Freeland, Washington

caused_by.evidence: The airplane continued in a nose-low, near-vertical descent until it impacted the water in Mutiny Bay

chain.label: Pilot and nine passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and nine passengers were fatally injured

caused_by.evidence: The pilot and nine passengers were fatally injured, and the airplane was destroyed
